name: Hoshino Resorts REIT, Inc.
summary: Hoshino Resorts REIT, Inc. (hereinafter, HRR) invests in hotels, ryokans (Japanese-style inns) and ancillary facilities. It serves at the core of the tourism industry and for which stable use is expected for the medium to long term. HRR was established under the Act on Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations (Act No. 198 of 1951, as amended; hereinafter, the Investment Trusts Act) with Hoshino Resort Asset Management Co., Ltd. (hereinafter, the Asset Management Company) as the organizer and investments in capital of 150 million yen (300 units) on March 6, 2013.
